stages.title: Stage 0.8 — MW VIP FREE GLOBAL INTERNET
stages.summary: Global Internet page and Update Center now show a seven-step rollout checklist. Previous UI foundation deployment succeeded; live satellite/network service is still not connected.
stages.requires: Complete the seven rollout milestones shown in milestones. Provider authorization, compatible infrastructure, sustainable subsidy and real-device acceptance tests are mandatory before marking service LIVE.

milestones.title: ১. GitHub Pages Deployment
milestones.summary: Global Internet UI foundation deployed successfully to GitHub Pages.
milestones.requires: Confirm this new checklist build also deploys and verify it in a browser.

milestones.title: ২. Satellite / Network Provider
milestones.requires: Choose an authorized provider that can supply internet in Bangladesh and intended coverage areas.

milestones.title: ৩. Authorized Contract & API
milestones.summary: No signed service agreement or provider API credentials configured.
milestones.requires: Obtain written authorization, technical documentation, API access and provider-side account approval; store secrets only server-side.

milestones.title: ৪. Satellite Device / Terminal
milestones.summary: No compatible terminal or direct-to-device service has been supplied or tested.
milestones.requires: Acquire provider-approved equipment and power; verify phone/device compatibility and lawful operation.

milestones.title: ৫. Gateway & Backhaul
milestones.summary: No authorized gateway/backhaul route is configured.
milestones.requires: Provider must provision the gateway, internet transit, coverage and network routing.

milestones.title: ৬. Funding for ৳০ Member Price
milestones.summary: ৳০ is the target price to members; operating budget is not yet confirmed.
milestones.requires: Secure sponsor, company, donor or partner funding for capacity, equipment, power, support and regulatory costs.

milestones.title: ৭. Real Internet Acceptance Tests
milestones.summary: Cannot test provider internet until provider, contract, equipment and backhaul are active.
milestones.requires: On real devices and each claimed coverage area, verify Google, YouTube, Facebook, WhatsApp, ordinary websites, speed, latency, outages, privacy and usage limits. Only then may service be marked LIVE.

stages.title: Stage 0.7 — Work & Earn Job Board
stages.summary: Responsive Work & Earn page with job search, category filters, member job posting, applications, applicant tracking, employer accept/reject controls and server-side RLS/RPC migration are in the repository.
stages.requires: Verify recoverable Supabase backup and restore test; apply 20261123100000_work_earn_job_board.sql through the protected migration workflow; test two accounts for job visibility, own-post controls, duplicate application denial, applicant privacy, employer review permissions and mobile Android navigation. No payments or guaranteed earnings are provided.

stages.requires: Deploy through GitHub Pages; deploy check-updates; apply 20261119200000_update_releases.sql; test update/no-update paths and offline navigation on Android. Confirm deployment workflow success.

stages.title: Stage 0.6 — Unified Inbox & Push Notification Foundation
stages.summary: Unified Inbox UI, direct/group thread list, unread counters, read markers, incoming/outgoing friend-request workflow, per-notification read markers, explicit browser push permission and per-user subscription storage, plus Service Worker push display/click handling are in the repository.
stages.requires: Verify Community, Admin/Broadcast and Inbox migrations in dependency order; configure VAPID public/private keys and trusted push sender server-side; test two-account privacy, subscription, delivery, unsubscribe, notification read status and Android Chrome/PWA behavior. Android WebView push is not guaranteed without native FCM.

stages.title: Stage 0 — One-Click Safe Setup
stages.summary: Consent-first local preferences, Yes/Review/Later flow, Dashboard status card, and a dedicated Workspace Settings page are connected. Settings can be reviewed/edited and saved to the same local preference store; optional analytics collection, OS/browser permissions, external account connections and legal consent remain off.
stages.requires: Verify Pages deployment; test Yes, Review/Edit, Settings save/reload, Dashboard status and persistence on Android/browser. Confirm language/theme preferences are represented correctly across the full UI before marking complete.
